findings.title: Keep the registered metric-alert handler instantiable
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now inherits four abstract members without implementing them: counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data. MetricAlertFire still registers this class, and Detector.detector_handler instantiates it unconditionally. Accessing the handler for a metric_alert_fire detector therefore raises TypeError and aborts process_detectors, whereas previously it returned no results. Implement the required members or retain a concrete no-op handler until the stateful implementation is ready.

findings.title: Build the expected occurrence for the group being evaluated
findings.body: The expected occurrence is built for "val1", but the evaluation below uses "group_key". Since build_mock_occurrence_and_event incorporates that argument into the fingerprint, the expected occurrence identifies a different issue from the actual occurrence. Build it using "group_key" and explicitly check the resulting fingerprint so this test validates that the new hook attributes occurrences to the evaluated detector group.
